cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Your cupboard's finished. I've left the shelves loose so you can choose the heights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They fall down. You haven't fitted the supports.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. It's complete as an adjustable kit. Position everything around your tins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you to install it. Here's the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll fasten one shelf at your chosen height. A finished sample, so you can approve the rest.

mechanism: Copied completion rituals let A recast unfinished work as an intentionally finished form.
confusable: Unlike avoiding work, A declares the current result complete; unlike mere bluff, A borrows a misunderstood cue.
comparison: Paid physical installation versus a public budget deadline.
seedUse: Use the loose shelves and empty report as incomplete-work pressures; replace the generic confident prefixes.
